current_formulation: DIHARD II scores diarization with full DER, without collars or overlap exclusion, plus the new Jaccard error rate.

steps.formulation: The NIST Rich Transcription evaluations introduce the diarization error rate. Known only through DIHARD II.
steps.quote: the RT evaluations introduced the diarization error rate (DER) metric

steps.formulation: Most later work scores a modified DER that excludes speech within 250 ms of boundaries and overlapped speech. Known only through DIHARD II.
steps.quote: the majority of this work has evaluated systems using a modified version of DER

criticism.quote: this may have resulted in an over-optimistic assessment of performance even within these domains

steps.formulation: DIHARD II uses full DER without collars or overlap exclusion, and adds the Jaccard error rate.
steps.quote: DER is adopted as the primary evaluation metric, but without use of collars or exclusion of overlapping speech.
